tagline: A fast-growing modern district on the far European shore — affordable, family-oriented, and further from the centre than it might seem.

items.name: Migros AVM Kafeler
items.description: The Migros mall complex has multiple café options — the most reliable stop for coffee in the area.

items.name: Sahil Cafés (Büyükçekmece)
items.description: The nearby Büyükçekmece lake and coastline have pleasant waterfront cafés popular with local families on weekends.

items.name: Beylikdüzü Sahil Restoranları
items.description: Restaurants along the Sea of Marmara coast in Beylikdüzü. Very local crowd, good value, and sea views.

items.name: Büyükçekmece Balık Restoranları
items.description: A cluster of fish restaurants by the Büyükçekmece lake and bridge area. Fresh fish at very reasonable prices.

items.name: Sahil Parkı
items.description: A long coastal park along the Marmara Sea with walking paths and sea views. Popular with local families for weekend walks.

items.name: Büyükçekmece Gölü
items.description: A large saltwater lake near Beylikdüzü, surrounded by park areas and restaurants. A peaceful escape further from the city.

tips: Beylikdüzü is on the M3 metro line — but the journey to the city centre takes 45-60 minutes. Plan your time accordingly.
Primarily a residential suburb popular with families. Not a destination in itself but a comfortable and affordable place to live.
Much more affordable housing than central Istanbul — popular with families priced out of Bakırköy or Şişli.
The coastal area and Büyükçekmece lake are the main reasons to venture this far west.
